101.summary: What every Warlock should know before choosing a spec: the Forever changes, the demon quests and the racial choice.

steps.text: Treat Curse of Agony and Curse of Doom as Banes: each Warlock keeps only one Bane on a target.
Curse of the Elements now covers every magic school, so it helps every caster in the group. Curse of Shadows is gone.
Put a Firestone or a Spellstone on your weapon. Both are weapon imbues that stack with Wizard Oil, so your off-hand slot stays free.
Count Spirit on your gear: Life Tap now scales with it.
Drain Soul's chance to give a Soul Shard rises with every tick until it is certain, and a non-trivial kill always gives one.
Swap demons between pulls: your current pet is stunned while you summon another one.

mistakes.mistake: Putting both Bane of Agony and Bane of Doom on one target.
mistakes.fix: Each Warlock can keep only one Bane on a target, so choose one.

mistakes.mistake: Leaving out Wizard Oil to keep a Firestone or Spellstone.
mistakes.fix: The stones are weapon imbues that stack with other temporary enchants such as Wizard Oil.

mistakes.mistake: Looking for Improved Healthstone in the Demonology tree.
mistakes.fix: It is no longer a talent. The 30 Oct datamine shows Healthstones healing as if fully talented; Blizzard's hotfix notes up to 11 November 2026 do not mention it.

steps.text: Each demon comes from a class quest: the Imp at level 1, the Voidwalker at 10, the Succubus and the Incubus at 20 and the Felhunter at 30.
The named quests are 'Devourer of Souls' for the Succubus, 'What Is Love?' in Stormwind for the Incubus and 'Seeking Strahad' for the Felhunter.
Buy grimoires from a demon trainer to teach your demons their abilities.
Create Soulstone comes at level 18 and Ritual of Summoning at 20 in the datamined spellbook. The ritual needs you plus two helpers.

mistakes.mistake: Waiting at a meeting stone for a summon.
mistakes.fix: Meeting stones reportedly do not summon in Forever, so Ritual of Summoning is the only summon.

steps.text: The Infernal quest (level 50) is known from Classic, where Niby the Almighty in Felwood asks for three Flawless Fel Essences. The Forever files list the spell at 50, but the quest is unverified.
Ritual of Doom (level 60) is also known from Classic, where it uses a Demonic Figurine and needs you plus four party members. How you unlock it in Forever is unverified.
Neither the Felsteed nor the Dreadsteed is in the datamined Forever spellbook, and no Forever source mentions them.

mistakes.mistake: Planning your level 40 mount around the Felsteed quest.
mistakes.fix: That quest is a Classic reference. Neither steed is in the datamined Forever spellbook, so check in game first.

steps.text: A Human gets +10% Spirit, and Life Tap now scales with Spirit.
A Gnome gets Eureka!: an 8 sec buff that makes non-periodic abilities 10% cheaper and stronger.
Eureka! leaves periodic effects out, so it adds more to direct spells such as Shadow Bolt than to Corruption or a Bane.

mistakes.mistake: Expecting Eureka! to strengthen your damage over time.
mistakes.fix: Eureka! affects non-periodic abilities only.

overview.lead: Affliction wins through damage over time: Corruption, Bane of Agony, Siphon Life and your drains. Wrack, at the bottom of the tree, channels Shadow damage and makes those effects tick faster while it lasts.

points.text: Suppression is the Warlock's hit talent: each rank gives 1% hit with all spells and 4% less threat, up to 5% hit at 5/5.
Pandemic raises the crit damage bonus of your DoTs and drains, and Malevolence adds Shadow crit.

101.summary: Leveling as Affliction, the core rotation and the curse tools that matter first.

steps.text: Improved Life Tap adds 10% more mana to Life Tap at rank 1 and 20% at rank 2.
Soul Harvest keeps you going between pulls: a non-trivial kill under your Drain Soul raises mana regeneration by 50% for 10 sec at rank 1 and lets 50% of it continue while you cast.
Improved Drains strengthens Drain Life, Drain Soul and Drain Mana by 7% at rank 1.
Siphon Life sits on row 5 and transfers 11 health from the target to you every 3 sec for 30 sec. Wrack, on row 7, requires it.

mistakes.mistake: Following an older guide that puts Wrack under Improved Drains.
mistakes.fix: In the current talent data Improved Drains covers Drain Life, Drain Soul and Drain Mana only.

mistakes.mistake: Skipping Siphon Life on the way down the tree.
mistakes.fix: Wrack requires Siphon Life.

steps.text: Apply Corruption first. Improved Corruption cuts its cast by 0.4 sec and adds 2% damage per rank, up to 2 sec and 10% at 5/5.
Keep one Bane and Siphon Life on the target. Each Warlock can keep only one Bane on a target.
With your effects running, channel Wrack: 60 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 6 sec, while your Siphon Life, Corruption and Bane of Agony tick 100% faster.
Fill with Shadow Bolt. Nightfall gives Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life and Wrack a 2% chance at rank 1 (4% at rank 2) to start a Shadow Trance, which makes your next Shadow Bolt instant.
Finish dying targets with Drain Soul: a non-trivial kill always gives a Soul Shard.

mistakes.mistake: Channeling Wrack before your effects are on the target.
mistakes.fix: Wrack speeds up only your Siphon Life, Corruption and Bane of Agony already on the target, so apply them first.

mistakes.mistake: Putting both Bane of Agony and Bane of Doom on one target.
mistakes.fix: Each Warlock can keep only one Bane on a target.

steps.text: Curse of Exhaustion slows a target by 30% for 12 sec. It sits on row 4 and requires Amplify Curse.
Amplify Curse (instant, 3 min cooldown) makes your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony 50% stronger, or your next Curse of Exhaustion 20% stronger. The effect lasts 30 sec.
Fel Concentration gives Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul and Wrack a 23% chance at rank 1 to keep their casting time when you take damage, and 70% at 3/3.
Grim Reach adds 10% range to your Affliction spells at rank 1 and 20% at rank 2.

mistakes.mistake: Keeping a Curse and a Bane on one target without checking that both stay.
mistakes.fix: The tooltips suggest one Curse and one Bane from you can share a target, but nobody has tested it.

overview.lead: Demonology puts your demon at the centre. Blizzard says the spec keeps enemies focused on the pet, and talents such as Demonic Knowledge, Soul Link and Master Demonologist reward you for fighting beside it.

points.text: Demonic Sacrifice lasts 2 hours and swapped its effects: the Imp now gives Shadow damage and the Succubus or Incubus Fire damage. Demonic Pact, at the bottom of the tree, keeps the sacrifice when you summon a different demon.
Demonic Brand makes Searing Pain mark the target so your pet's next attacks deal bonus Fire or Shadow damage; only the Shadow damage carries high threat.

101.summary: Leveling as Demonology, the core rotation and the bottom of the tree.

steps.text: Demonic Brand sits on row 4 of the Demonology tree.
Unholy Power adds 2% to all damage your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus and Felhunter deal at rank 1, and 10% at 5/5.
Improved Voidwalker strengthens Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice and Suffering by 10% at rank 1.

Master Summoner cuts summoning casts by 2 sec and their mana cost by 20% at rank 1. Fel Domination requires it and cuts your next summon's casting time by 5.5 sec and its mana cost by 50%, on a 5 min cooldown.

mistakes.mistake: Summoning a new demon in the middle of a pull.
mistakes.fix: Your current pet is stunned while you summon another one, so swap demons between pulls.

mistakes.mistake: Saving a point for Fel Domination without Master Summoner.
mistakes.fix: Fel Domination requires Master Summoner.

steps.text: Open with Searing Pain. With one point in Demonic Brand it marks the target for 10 sec, and your pet's next 2 attacks against it deal 65 to 68 Fire or Shadow damage.

Nuke with Shadow Bolt. Decimation cuts Soul Fire's cooldown by 45% at rank 1, and after a Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, Soul Fire casts 20% faster and costs no Soul Shards for 10 sec.
Keep the pet alive: Demonic Energies heals it for 8% of your spell damage at rank 1, and Improved Health Funnel lets you use Health Funnel whatever your demon's health.
Match the demon to the job: the Imp brings Blood Pact and Fire Shield, the Felhunter Spell Lock and Devour Magic.

mistakes.mistake: Counting on the brand's Fire damage to hold threat for your pet.
mistakes.fix: Only Shadow damage from Demonic Brand carries high threat.

mistakes.mistake: Waiting out Soul Fire's normal cooldown on a low target.
mistakes.fix: After Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, Decimation makes Soul Fire faster and free of Soul Shards for 10 sec.

steps.text: Soul Link requires Demonic Sacrifice. While it is active, 30% of the damage you take goes to your demon, and both of you deal 3% more damage.

Master Demonologist pairs the opposite way to Demonic Sacrifice: the Imp for Fire damage, the Voidwalker for less physical damage taken, the Succubus or Incubus for Shadow damage and the Felhunter for less magic damage taken.
Plan the bottom of the tree early: Demonic Pact requires Soul Link, and Soul Link requires Demonic Sacrifice.
Improved Felhunter cuts Spell Lock's cooldown by 2 sec at rank 1.

mistakes.mistake: Expecting Soul Link to protect you with no demon out.
mistakes.fix: Soul Link lasts only as long as the demon is active.

overview.lead: Destruction deals direct damage: Shadow Bolt, Immolate and Conflagrate early, then Incinerate at 31 points, a 2.5 sec cast that deals 25% more damage to Immolated targets.

points.text: Bane of Havoc, on row 5, afflicts one target for 5 min, and that target also takes 15% of the damage you deal to other targets.
Shadow and Flame rewards mixing schools: Conflagrate raises your Shadow damage and Shadowburn your Fire damage, by 4% for 20 sec at rank 1.

101.summary: Leveling as Destruction, the core rotation and the crit and stun talents.

steps.text: Molten Skin cuts all damage taken by 2% at rank 1, and Intensity gives your Destruction spells a 23% chance at rank 1 to keep their casting time when you are hit.
Conflagrate sits on row 4 and Bane of Havoc on row 5. Incinerate, at the bottom of the tree, requires Bane of Havoc.
Aftermath raises Immolate's initial damage by 10% and gives Conflagrate a 20% chance to Daze the target (50% slower for 5 sec) at rank 1.

mistakes.mistake: Skipping Bane of Havoc on the way to Incinerate.
mistakes.fix: Incinerate requires Bane of Havoc.

steps.text: Apply Immolate first; Aftermath raises its initial damage by 10% at rank 1.
Conflagrate an Immolated target. It consumes your Immolate unless Shadow and Flame saves it: a 20% chance at rank 1, and every time at 5/5.
Fill with Incinerate while Immolate is up, for 25% more damage; otherwise cast Shadow Bolt.
With two or more enemies, put Bane of Havoc on a second target: it takes 15% of the damage you deal to the others.
Finish low targets with Shadowburn, an instant blast. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of it, you gain a Soul Shard.

mistakes.mistake: Casting Incinerate after Conflagrate has consumed Immolate.
mistakes.fix: Incinerate's extra 25% applies only to a target afflicted by Immolate, so check that Immolate is still up.

chapters.title: Crits, stuns and Improved Shadow Bolt

Fire and Brimstone adds 8% crit chance to Conflagrate at rank 1.

steps.text: Bane at 5/5 cuts Shadow Bolt, Immolate and Incinerate casts by 0.5 sec and Soul Fire by 2 sec.
Shadow and Flame at 5/5: Conflagrate never consumes Immolate, Shadowburn always refunds a Soul Shard, and each raises the other school's damage by 20% for 20 sec.
Ruin at 5/5 adds 100% to the crit damage bonus of your Destruction spells, and Agonizing Flames at 3/3 adds 10% to their damage.

mistakes.mistake: Using an older guide's Shadow and Flame values.
mistakes.fix: The current data gives 4% at rank 1 and 20% at 5/5.

steps.text: Incinerate is a 2.5 sec cast that deals 25% more damage to Immolated targets, so keep Immolate up.
Bane cuts Shadow Bolt, Immolate and Incinerate casts by 0.1 sec and Soul Fire by 0.4 sec at rank 1, up to 0.5 sec and 2 sec at 5/5.
Get spell hit from Suppression, on Affliction row 1: Destruction has no hit talent.
Read 16% against bosses three levels higher as a Classic 1.12 number, not a Forever one.

mistakes.mistake: Looking for a hit talent in the Destruction tree.
mistakes.fix: There is none; Suppression in Affliction is the Warlock's hit source.

steps.text: Match the stone to your filler: Firestone (Fire damage and spell crit) for Incinerate and Conflagrate, Spellstone (Shadow damage and spell haste) for Shadow Bolt. Both stack with Wizard Oil.
Expect no Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer in a raid: Forever data marks it 'No effect while in a raid instance'.
For Onyxia, read the Classic 1.12 fire resistance list (Onyxia Scale Cloak, Drakefire Amulet, Juju Ember, the cloak enchant and fire protection potions) as a reference only.
Read the Classic 1.12 caster kit as a reference, not a list checked in Forever.

mistakes.mistake: Counting on Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer inside the raid.
mistakes.fix: Forever data marks it 'No effect while in a raid instance'.

steps.text: Your Improved Shadow Bolt debuff boosts only your own Shadow damage, so it no longer helps the raid.
On fights with more than one enemy, keep Bane of Havoc on one target for 5 min: it takes 15% of the damage you deal to other targets.
Cataclysm makes your Destruction spells cost 3% less mana for one point and 10% less at 3/3.
In the files Curse of the Elements has 4 ranks; the top rank lowers magic resistances by 75 and adds 10% magic damage taken from all schools.
Hand out Healthstones, which heal outside the potion cooldown, and keep a Soulstone up for a combat resurrection.

mistakes.mistake: Casting Bane of Havoc on a fight with a single enemy.
mistakes.fix: It pays off only when more than one enemy is up, because its target takes a share of the damage you deal to other targets.

steps.text: Your control comes from Aftermath's Conflagrate Daze (50% slower for 5 sec) and Pyroclasm's 3 sec stun chance on Soul Fire, Rain of Fire and Hellfire.
Shadowburn is your instant finisher.
Molten Skin at 5/5 cuts all damage you take by 10%, and Intensity at 3/3 gives a 70% chance to keep your casting time when you are hit.

mistakes.mistake: Expecting every Conflagrate to Daze with one point in Aftermath.
mistakes.fix: Aftermath gives a 20% chance at rank 1 and a 100% chance at 5/5.
